CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_studentFts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `students` BEGIN DELETE FROM `studentFts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_studentFts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `students` BEGIN INSERT INTO `studentFts`(`docid`, `name`, `school`, `phone`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`name`, NEW.`school`, NEW.`phone`); END
